summary: Verified timezone fix for Supplier Election System. The main fix changed datetime.now(timezone.utc) to datetime.now(OMAN_TZ) where OMAN_TZ = timezone(timedelta(hours=4)). All 8 requested features tested and working correctly.

GET_elections_list_status.evidence: API returns status='nomination' for active election with nomination_start=2026-04-12T13:15

GET_elections_candidates.evidence: Returns 4 candidates with full details (id, name, supplier_code, center_name, etc.)

POST_register_candidate.description: Verify supplier can register as candidate during nomination period
POST_register_candidate.evidence: Successfully registered supplier 2015 as candidate, returned candidate object with registered_at in Oman timezone

GET_lookup_supplier.description: Verify supplier lookup works with code 2015
GET_lookup_supplier.evidence: Returns {found: true, supplier: {name, national_id, center_name, milk_type, phone}}

frontend_supplier_voting_status.description: Frontend /supplier-voting shows elections with correct status 'الترشيح مفتوح'
frontend_supplier_voting_status.evidence: Screenshot confirms badge shows 'الترشيح مفتوح' (Nomination Open), NOT 'لم يبدأ بعد' (Not Started)

frontend_nomination_form.description: Clicking election shows nomination form with all fields
frontend_nomination_form.evidence: Form visible with: name input, national ID input, center select, supply type input, register button

frontend_supplier_lookup_autofill.evidence: Lookup code 2022 auto-filled name='Ahmed Mohammed Said Ghafram Al Shahri', national_id, center_name, milk_type

admin_elections_status_badge.description: Admin page /supplier-elections shows election with correct status badge
admin_elections_status_badge.evidence: Screenshot confirms badge shows 'ترشيح مفتوح' (Nominations Open), NOT 'مسودة' (Draft)

seed_data_creation: None - used existing election 'انتخاب عضو للموردين' with nomination period 13:15-13:31 Oman time
context_for_next_testing_agent: Timezone fix verified. Key change: get_election_status() in election_routes.py now uses OMAN_TZ = timezone(timedelta(hours=4)) instead of UTC. Election status correctly shows 'nomination' during nomination period. Current election has 4 candidates registered.

timezone_fix_verification.before_fix: Server used datetime.now(timezone.utc) causing 4-hour offset, status showed 'draft' when it should be 'nomination'
timezone_fix_verification.after_fix: Server uses datetime.now(OMAN_TZ) where OMAN_TZ = timezone(timedelta(hours=4)), status correctly shows 'nomination'
